hint: Burj Khalifa: extremely tall and slim, height about 10 times the base width. Y-shaped tripod: a central round core plus 3 box wings arranged 120 degrees apart around it. Build about 9 stacked tiers; each tier is the core cylinder plus 3 wings, and every tier the wings get shorter and shift inward so the tower tapers and spirals. Silver-blue glass color 0x9fb8cc with darker trim 0x5f7f99. A wide low podium at the base. A thin tall spire cylinder on top, about 15 percent of the total height.

Eiffel Tower: 4 curved slanted legs from a wide square base meeting at a first platform, a second smaller platform higher up, then a narrow tapering shaft and a thin spire. Iron brown color 0x6b5a4a. Cross braces between the legs, arches at the base.
Great Pyramid: square base pyramid made with a ConeGeometry with 4 radial segments rotated 45 degrees, sand color 0xd9b779, wide and not too tall. Optionally two smaller pyramids beside it.

Taj Mahal: wide white marble platform, central cube building with a large onion dome (sphere plus a cone finial), 4 small domed kiosks around it, 4 tall slim minarets at the platform corners, a thin reflecting pool strip in front. White 0xf3efe6.
Statue of Liberty: square stone pedestal, robed standing figure in green copper color 0x5fa89a, one raised arm holding a torch, other arm holding a tablet, a crown with 7 spikes on the head.
Big Ben: tall square stone tower in sandy color 0xc9b280, a clock face block near the top with a white disc and dark hands, a pointed pyramid roof with a small spire, small corner turrets.
Colosseum: wide oval ring of 3 stacked arched tiers, built as stacked hollow-looking cylinders with dark arch openings, sand color 0xd2b48c, partly broken on one side, open arena in the middle.
